question:
[UPSC CSAT 2026 · Q43]
A person saves 10% of his salary every month. If his salary increases by 12% and the expenditure increases by 10%, then what will be the change in his saving per month?
explanation:
Answer: B. (UPSC has not yet released the 2026 answer key; the answer is worked out below.)
Take the salary as 100: saving 10, expenditure 90.
New salary = 112 and new expenditure = 99, so the new saving = 112 − 99 = 13.
The saving rises from 10 to 13, a 30% increase.
question_hi:
[UPSC सीसैट 2026 · प्रश्न 43]
एक व्यक्ति प्रत्येक महीने अपने वेतन के 10% की बचत करता है। यदि उसके वेतन में 12% की वृद्धि होती है और उसका व्यय 10% बढ़ जाता है, तो उसकी प्रति माह होने वाली बचत में क्या परिवर्तन होगा?
explanation_hi:
उत्तर: B। (UPSC ने 2026 की उत्तर कुंजी अभी जारी नहीं की है; उत्तर नीचे हल करके दिखाया गया है।)
वेतन 100 मानिए: बचत 10, व्यय 90।
नया वेतन = 112 और नया व्यय = 99, अतः नई बचत = 112 − 99 = 13।
बचत 10 से 13 हो जाती है, अर्थात 30% वृद्धि।

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2025 · Q9]
Team X scored a total of N runs in 20 overs. Team Y tied the score in 10% less overs. Had team Y's average run rate (runs per over) been 50% higher, the scores would have been tied in 12 overs. How many runs were scored by team X?
explanation:
Answer: D.
Team Y made the N runs in 10% fewer overs: 20 − 2 = 18 overs, so its run rate was N/18 per over.
With a 50% higher rate, it would be 1.5 × N/18 = N/12 per over, and N runs would take N ÷ (N/12) = 12 overs.
This holds for every value of N, so the data cannot fix N: it cannot be determined.
question_hi:
[UPSC सीसैट 2025 · प्रश्न 9]
टीम X ने 20 ओवर में कुल N रन बनाए। टीम Y ने 10% कम ओवर में बराबर स्कोर बनाया। यदि टीम Y की औसत रन दर (रन प्रति ओवर) 50% अधिक होती, तो यह स्कोर 12 ओवर में बराबर हो गया होता। टीम X द्वारा कितने रन बनाए गए?
options_hi: D) निर्धारित नहीं किया जा सकता
answer_hi: D) निर्धारित नहीं किया जा सकता
explanation_hi:
उत्तर: D।
टीम Y ने N रन 10% कम ओवर में बनाए: 20 − 2 = 18 ओवर, अतः उसकी रन दर N/18 प्रति ओवर थी।
50% अधिक होने पर दर 1.5 × N/18 = N/12 प्रति ओवर होती, और N रन बनाने में N ÷ (N/12) = 12 ओवर लगते।
यह N के हर मान के लिए सही है, इसलिए आँकड़ों से N तय नहीं होता: निर्धारित नहीं किया जा सकता।

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2025 · Q10]
The price (p) of a commodity is first increased by k%; then decreased by k%; again increased by k%; and again decreased by k%. If the new price is q, then what is the relation between p and q?
explanation:
Answer: A.
Each rise multiplies the price by (1 + k/100) and each fall by (1 − k/100).
q = p × (1 + k/100)(1 − k/100) × (1 + k/100)(1 − k/100) = p × (1 − k²/10⁴)² = p × (10⁴ − k²)²/10⁸.
So p(10⁴ − k²)² = q × 10⁸.
question_hi:
[UPSC सीसैट 2025 · प्रश्न 10]

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2025 · Q17]
The petrol price shot up by 10% as a result of the hike in crude oil prices. The price of petrol before the hike was ₹ 90 per litre. A person travels 2200 km every month and his car gives a mileage of 16 km per litre. By how many km should he reduce his travel if he wants to maintain his expenditure at the previous level?
explanation:
Answer: B.
New price = 90 × 1.1 = ₹ 99 per litre.
Earlier monthly spend = (2200 ÷ 16) × 90 = 137.5 × 90 = ₹ 12,375.
At ₹ 99 per litre this buys 12,375 ÷ 99 = 125 litres, enough for 125 × 16 = 2000 km.
So he must cut his travel by 2200 − 2000 = 200 km.
(Shortcut: with the same spend, distance varies inversely with the price, so the new distance = 2200 ÷ 1.1 = 2000 km.)
question_hi:
[UPSC सीसैट 2025 · प्रश्न 17]
कच्चे तेल की कीमतों में वृद्धि होने के कारण पेट्रोल की कीमतें 10% बढ़ गईं। कीमत-वृद्धि से पहले पेट्रोल की कीमत ₹ 90 प्रति लीटर थी। कोई व्यक्ति प्रति माह 2200 km की यात्रा करता है और उसकी कार 16 km प्रति लीटर माइलेज देती है। यदि वह अपना खर्च पिछले स्तर पर बनाए रखना चाहता है, तो उसे अपनी यात्रा में कितने km की कमी करनी चाहिए?
explanation_hi:
उत्तर: B।
नई कीमत = 90 × 1.1 = ₹ 99 प्रति लीटर।
पहले का मासिक खर्च = (2200 ÷ 16) × 90 = 137.5 × 90 = ₹ 12,375।
₹ 99 प्रति लीटर की दर से इतने में 12,375 ÷ 99 = 125 लीटर मिलेगा, जो 125 × 16 = 2000 km के लिए पर्याप्त है।
अतः उसे अपनी यात्रा 2200 − 2000 = 200 km कम करनी होगी।
(संक्षिप्त विधि: खर्च समान रहने पर दूरी कीमत के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होती है, अतः नई दूरी = 2200 ÷ 1.1 = 2000 km।)

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2024 · Q26]
P's salary is 20% lower than Q's salary which is 20% lower than R's salary. By how much percent is R's salary more than P's salary?
explanation:
Answer: B.
Take R = 100. Q is 20% lower: Q = 80. P is 20% lower than Q: P = 64.
R is more than P by 36, and 36/64 × 100 = 56.25%.

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2024 · Q27]
A number is mistakenly divided by 4 instead of multiplying by 4. What is the percentage change in the result due to this mistake?
explanation:
Answer: D.
Let the number be x. The correct result is 4x; the result obtained is x/4.
Change = 4x − x/4 = 15x/4. As a percentage of the correct result: (15x/4) ÷ (4x) × 100 = 15/16 × 100 = 93.75%.
question_hi:
[UPSC सीसैट 2024 · प्रश्न 27]
एक संख्या को 4 से गुणा करने के बदले गलती से 4 से विभाजित किया गया है। इस गलती के कारण परिणाम में प्रतिशत अंतर कितना होगा?
explanation_hi:
उत्तर: D।
मान लीजिए संख्या x है। सही परिणाम 4x है; प्राप्त परिणाम x/4 है।
अंतर = 4x − x/4 = 15x/4। सही परिणाम के प्रतिशत के रूप में: (15x/4) ÷ (4x) × 100 = 15/16 × 100 = 93.75%।

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2024 · Q28]
In an examination, 80% of students passed in English, 70% of students passed in Hindi and 15% failed in both the subjects. What is the percentage of students who failed in only one subject?
explanation:
Answer: B.
Failed in English = 100 − 80 = 20%; failed in Hindi = 100 − 70 = 30%; failed in both = 15%.
Failed only in English = 20 − 15 = 5%; failed only in Hindi = 30 − 15 = 15%.
Failed in only one subject = 5 + 15 = 20%.

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2024 · Q47]
A person buys three articles P, Q and R for ₹ 3,330. If P costs 25% more than R and R costs 20% more than Q, then what is the cost of P?
explanation:
Answer: D.
Let Q cost x. R costs 20% more: 1.2x. P costs 25% more than R: 1.25 × 1.2x = 1.5x.
Total: x + 1.2x + 1.5x = 3.7x = 3330, so x = 900.
P = 1.5 × 900 = ₹ 1,350.

question:
[UPSC CSAT 2022 · Q20]
The increase in the price of a certain item was 25%. Then the price was decreased by 20% and then again increased by 10%. What is the resultant increase in the price?
explanation:
Answer: B.
Take the price as 100.
After +25%: 125. After −20%: 125 × 0.8 = 100. After +10%: 110.
Resultant increase = 10%.
